largest_vegas_favorite.note: Largest raw Vegas favorite this week (-800 ML, -12.5 vs ARI, ~85% no-vig implied). Never the recommendation by policy. status_note: Eliminated from the main prize (1 mistake: Week 2 TB). Playing for fewest mistakes, so no opportunity-cost logic: the recommendation is the highest Arbiter probability among non-excluded, unused teams.
process_note: Byes: CIN, DET, MIA, MIN. Shortlist of 12 got the full Advocate/Skeptic/Arbiter debate, including already-used SF, JAX and TB (marked used_in_this_pool) so the board works for other survivor pools. Excluded from recommendation: LA (largest Vegas favorite), BAL (trap flag), and used teams SF/JAX/TB. board.summary: The Positives are concrete and mostly hold up: ARI's confirmed OUTs at RB and safety, the MHJ trade, the league-best yardage gap, a clean LA injury report, and the line moving toward LA. The kicking crisis and the short week after OT are real but modest, and the L11 division haircut plus L2 caution put it a few points under market. Excluded as the week's largest Vegas favorite.

negatives: LA only 2-3 despite the yardage; efficiency isn't converting to wins

Division game with a big spread (L11); largest raw-ML favorite on the board (L2)

board.venue_history: ARI has rarely won at SoFi since it opened in 2020. Short trip, no time-zone change.
board.rest_prep: LA on a short week (played Monday night Week 5, OT); ARI on normal rest after a home game. No road-trip stacking for ARI (short trip from Glendale).
